{{Quote|I will not be insulted nor patronized. Beg me. Beg me for mercy, and I will kill you quickly.|Darth Vengean|<ref name="Power Play">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Power Play|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Vengean''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]; he was the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of [[Darth Baras]] and a member of the [[Dark Council]]. He was the Dark Council's military leader and a warmonger seeking to re-ignite war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and finally exterminate the foe that drove the Sith into exile a millennium earlier. Vengean was openly outraged when the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed into law, criticizing all who supported the peace accord and even quietly disparaging the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. His survival of such insolence was a testament to his power. Darth Vengean and Baras spent years carrying out deft political manipulations and quiet assassinations in tandem, both against the Republic and within the Empire.

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Vengean began plotting to [[Plan Zero|reignite]] the war. He tasked Baras with eliminating General [[Karastace Gonn]], who had been preventing the Empire from conquering the fringe systems. Baras dispatched his latest apprentice, a powerful [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]], to perform this task. This allowed Vengean to dispatch his flagship to begin his conquest. However, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk]], revealed to be Baras' [[Spy/Legends|spy]], was waiting and [[Battle for Darth Vengean's flagship|ambushed the flagship]], destroying Vengean's credibility and dissolving the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].

When Plan Zero was completed, Baras recalled the Warrior back to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to discuss Vengean's downfall. Because of his blunder at [[Quesh]], the [[Dark Council]] called for Vengean's head. Baras sent the Warrior into Vengean's sanctum to free [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Draahg]], Vengean's apprentice, who was secretly working for Baras. But Vengean found out before the warrior could rescue Draahg and incarcerated him. After freeing Draahg, the two worked together to break into Vengean's inner sanctum, where the Dark Lord was gathering his strength. Faced with his opponents, Vengean swore to bleed Draahg anew before turning to the Warrior. He reminded the young Sith that Baras wouldn't have gotten to where he was today without the help of his strong enforcer. He called Baras a coward, plotting from the shadows, whereas the Warrior and Vengean himself were people of action. Vengean proceeded to duel with the apprentice of Baras and lost, allowing Baras to ascend to Vengean's seat on the Dark Council.

==Personality and traits==
Darth Vengean was a Human male with pale skin and orange eyes. Vengean was known as a man of action and a warmonger. He hated those who betrayed him, as he threatened to bleed Draahg and destroy Baras for betraying him.

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Vengean was skilled with his single-bladed [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]]. Vengean was also powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and was capable of [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force choke]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].
